svg.title: The Compute Community Centre: a modern commons based on the public library model, costed and in design, site to be chosen
svg.desc: A light 3D model of the building, after the study model on economyofwisdom.org: 100 by 80 feet, four glass levels and a planted roof. The levels lift apart and close on a loop. Labelled from the ground up: the compute room, with 19 eight-GPU nodes in four racks by the street glass; the commons and cafeteria, with 48 public AI terminals; rest and exercise, with eight sleeping pods; twelve homes; the planted roof.
svg.text: A modern commons based on the public library model,
open to anyone who walks in.
COSTED · IN DESIGN · SITE TO BE CHOSEN
